hooks.command: ST=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('subagent_type',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$ST" in Explore|general-purpose)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: knowledge graph at graphify-out/. Before spawning this exploration agent, try graphify yourself first: run graphify query <seeded with an actual class/function/file name, not a vague phrase> (or graphify explain / graphify path). One good query often returns the whole relevant slice in seconds - cheaper than a subagent trace. Only fall back to this agent if graphify does not surface enough."}}'   || true ;; esac

[ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && git status --porcelain -- '*.go' '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.sql' '*.proto' 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && find . \( -name node_modules -o -name graphify-out -o -name .git \) -prune -o \( -name '*.go' -o -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.sql' -o -name '*.proto' \) -newer graphify-out/graph.json -print 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"graphify-out/ is stale relative to source changes made this turn. Run `graphify update .` before finishing."}' || true

git status --porcelain -- graphify-out 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && PREV=$(git log -1 --format=%s --invert-grep --grep='^\[Graphify\]' 2>/dev/null) && git add -- graphify-out && git commit --quiet -m "[Graphify] chore: update code graph after ${PREV:-source changes}" -- graphify-out || true
